channel.title: Shots
channel.description: Updates for Shots, the agent-first App Store screenshot app.

item.title: 0.5.0-beta.4
item.description:
What changed since v0.5.0-beta.3

  • Let a beta build take beta updates from Sparkle
  • Park the deletes minors by name
  • Record the deletes merge
  • Pin the engine with deletes
  • Close the project window itself once its project is in the Trash
  • Park how a deleted shot comes back
  • Keep the window open and say why when Move Project to Trash fails
  • Refuse Delete Shot during any run and let go of takes for a deleted shot
  • Delete a shot from the set, the gallery or with Command-Delete
  • Move the open project to the Trash from the File menu
  • Keep the launcher trash test off the real logs folder
  • Move a project to the Trash from the launcher
  • Move a project to the Trash with its logs and last-opened date
  • Take new screen ids from the project's counter
  • Add the deletes plan and align the spec with it
  • Add the deletes design
  • Park the in-app What's New run idea
  • Record the 0.5.0 beta 3 release

item.title: 0.5.0-beta.3
item.description:
What changed since v0.5.0-beta.2

  • Record the push and park the defaults baseline on a re-stage
  • Record the title cards merge and the restored live pass
  • Keep the recents baseline across a re-stage and update the status
  • Correct the serial swift test flag in the notes
  • Let a look restyle title cards, clearing their own style
  • Pin a take whose longer headline wraps into the icon as refused
  • Refuse a title card take whose elements overlap or run off the canvas
  • Give a recreated title card the listing card's backdrop and colours
  • Park the title-cards review minors
  • Hide a title card's captures and name a half-built card when the icon fails
  • Read the App Store listing through shots-mcp so a run can recreate a card
  • Teach the shoot and variants skills title cards and pin the element-layers engine
  • Offer takes on a title card
  • Point annotations at a title card's elements
  • Stamp each capture a card shows in its render key
  • Show a title card's render wherever a screen is shown
  • Let a take reword and move a title card's elements
  • Add the element tools for text cards, from the text-card branch without reference crops
  • Renumber screens only when add_screen is given a position
  • Let add_screen make a text card at a position
  • Write the title cards plan
  • Write the title cards design
  • Record four lessons from the Match pass
  • Record Match done and pushed
  • Record the Restore pass and the count ruling
  • Count only the screenshots Claude reads on the Match card
  • Record the eval and iPad-only rulings
  • Let Match read an iPad-only listing
  • Record the Match copy ruling and the fixed minors
  • Hand the App Store client to every run store through the registry
  • Decode Match's thumbnails small and write its download off the main actor
  • Show one Stop when a Match run stalls
  • Offer Try again when the lock is taken during Match's download
  • Check the Match eval's face is SF Pro
  • Ask App Store Connect for Match's one app by bundle id
  • Record the Match merge and push
  • Record the Match live pass and its open rulings
  • Keep the selected screen on the stage while Match runs and once it's done
  • Hold every run during Match's download and show Match only while it runs
  • Read a white headline by luminance in the Match eval
  • Add a gated eval for Match App Store look
  • Show Match App Store look in the More menu, the band and every row
  • Download the listing before Match starts Claude, with Stop and Try again
  • Add the Match App Store look run and let new shots follow the set
  • Download the live listing into the project's look folder
  • Record the beta and Match plan status
  • Plan Match App Store look
  • Spec Match App Store look

First release

  • Record M5b as merged
  • Record the Sparkle key as backed up
  • Record M5b as built and reviewed, awaiting the merge
  • Build Shots on GitHub's runner
  • Pin the engine commit CI builds against
  • Sign updates with the Shots key and refuse a placeholder
  • Release Shots from a tag with GitHub Actions
  • Ask before replacing Shots in Applications and drop the download's quarantine
  • Update Shots with Sparkle and build a signed release with one script
  • Pin the packages the app now resolves
  • Connect Shots to Claude Code and move it to Applications on first launch
  • Let a Stop reach children launched off the main thread
  • Build shots-mcp and shots-capture into the app with the skill and driver
  • Give both tools a shared entry point and find the driver inside the app
  • Find the tools inside the app unless a Settings path says otherwise
  • Build Shots on GitHub's runner
  • Record three lessons from M5a's live pass and polish
  • Record the M5b plan as next in the status
  • Write the Milestone 5b plan and align the spec with Brio's feed
  • Write the Milestone 5b distribution spec
